articleTitle: Phishing Attacks Isolation via DNS Prevention of 64-Bit Time Synchronized Public Key
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Phishing attack is very big problem in the field of internet security. To combat phishing and domain name system (DNS) spoofing, authors work implements a quick authentication system. In DNS spoofing, an attacker clones of IP address and inserts a fake DNS server, which redirects network traffic to the incorrect destination. In phishing, phisher (sales and industrial espionage) clones the legitimate website, which the user believes that is his/her original website. We can host a phishing website but can't relay links through popular hosting sites such as Google or Facebook. To route users to phony servers, phishers utilize DNS spoofing through fake DNS servers to trick legitimate users to click on phishing URLs. As a result, our suggested solution decouples DNS spoofing and phishing assaults with 64-bit time- synchronized public-key cryptography to prevent them.

articleTitle: Recognition of Attacks on IoT Devices and Their Prevention Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has caused a revolution in many different industries by making it possible for connected smart devices to communicate with one another effortlessly. However, due to the growing number of potential access points for assaults, this interconnectivity also presents substantial issues for the maintenance of information security. This research article investigates the application of deep learning methods to identify and prevent attacks against the IoT. We give a comprehensive examination of ANN and DNN based on deep learning to improve the security and resilience of Internet of Things networks. The effectiveness of the suggested model is evaluated in this paper through tests conducted on data taken from the real world, revealing the ability of the model to protect IoT devices from being compromised by cyberattacks. Accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 score are the measures of evaluation that are utilized in the process of comparing and contrasting performance. The system passed the DNN accuracy test with a score of 99%.

articleTitle: Classification of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Using MobileNet and EfficientNetB3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Computer vision and deep learning are widely used in health care. Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia (ALL) is a severe form of malignancy that affects the body's white blood cells. An early and precise diagnosis of ALL is critical for successful therapy and improved patient outcomes. In this project, the effectiveness of deep learning techniques including MobileNet and EfficientNetB3 are explored in conjunction with data augmentation for the classification of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) using C-NMC Leukemia Classification Dataset. The approach of this project involves generating augmented data using various techniques such as flipping, rotating, and zooming to remove data imbalance in a dataset. After that split the data into training and testing data and then fine-tune the MobileNet and EfficientNetB3 models on the trained data, and evaluate the performance of both models using testing data based on recall, accuracy, F1score, precision, and Area Under Curve.

articleTitle: CyberShield: Advanced Encryption and Decryption Techniques for Video Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: With the increased usage of video communication technologies, the requirement for secure video data transfer has grown more critical than ever. Video encryption methods are critical in preventing unauthorized access to sensitive video data while it is provided across insecure networks. This study compares several video encryption algorithms, including symmetric and asymmetric key-based encryption methods. The goal of this research is to compare the security, computational complexity, and transmission overhead of several video encryption techniques. The research includes an examination of well-known encryption algorithms that include AES (Advanced Encryption Standard), RSA (Rivest-Shamir-Adelman) and DES (Data Encryption Standard), as well as variants on these techniques. Furthermore, this work offers a hybrid video encryption method that combines symmetric and asymmetric key-based encryption approaches to provide good security while being computationally simple. The experimental results reveal that the proposed method is more successful and effective than existing video encryption techniques. The suggested method used to secure video data communication over unsecured networks such as the internet, assuring the video data's secrecy, integrity, and authenticity.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Blockchain-Based IoT System for Privacy-Preserving Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In this study, we suggest a unique strategy to tackle security issues in heterogeneous IoT systems by combining an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model with a decentralized Blockchain-based framework built on BigchainDB. The suggested approach emphasizes data exchange while protecting privacy and it also improves capabilities for threat and anomaly detection. With the suggested approach, we are able to detect anomalies and intrusions with a remarkable 97% accuracy. It is evaluated using the NSL-KDD dataset, a popular benchmark dataset. With the help of features like data privacy, access control, and immutability, the system makes use of BigChainDB's decentralized and secure nature to guarantee the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of data. The suggested ANN model, trained on the data set NSL-KDD, has excellent performance, allowing efficient pattern analysis and prompt alarms to improve the overall safety of the IoT system. The system also includes a mechanism that, in the event of an attack, isolates the affected node and directs data exchange via the alternate node, assuring continuous and safe communication. The excellence of the suggested model is supported by studies and comparative assessments, which also emphasize how well it handles security issues.

articleTitle: A Survey on Security Attacks on Blockchain Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Securing decentralized networks becomes crucial as blockchain technology grows more popular. This study suggests a system for intrusion detection that combines blockchain features with deep learning. Blockchain's tamper-resistance and deep learning's aptitude for pattern identification offer better threat detection and adaptive defenses. Empirical tests demonstrate this strategy's potential to strengthen developing blockchain security, which would be a huge advancement in cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Blockchain Implementation with Hyperledger Fabric and Approach for Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain is a decentralized and distributed digital ledger technology that has gained significant attention and recognition in recent years. It holds great significance due to its potential to revolutionize various industries and address several challenges associated with traditional centralized systems. While blockchain technology has garnered significant attention and potential, its adoption has been relatively slower due to the technical complexity involved in developing and integrating blockchain solutions poses a barrier for many organizations and individuals who may not have the necessary skills or resources. Despite this challenge, the blockchain ecosystem continues to evolve due to its huge advantages. Even to reduce the complexity, there are several blockchain frameworks available that provide developers with tools and platforms to build and deploy blockchain applications easily. This research work is making an effort to use one such framework to implement real life problems on blockchain platform in a simplified manner. Hyperledger Fabric has gained popularity for enterprise blockchain use cases, such as supply chain management, finance, healthcare, and more. Its focus on privacy, scalability, permissioning, and modular architecture which makes it suitable for organizations that require control, flexibility, and interoperability in their blockchain deployments. At last, this study also demonstrates the way to evaluate blockchain network performance.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Approach to Personalized Stress Alleviation: Integrating EEG-Guided Music Recommendation for Enhanced Therapeutic Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Due to numerous variables, including the covid-19 pandemic, economic unpredictability and climate change, nowadays a significant amount of stress and depression is experienced by individuals. Chronic stress can put your health at higher risk of health concerns. This serious health problem can be addressed by analysing electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and detecting the stress levels. This paper proposes Stress Detection and Music Therapy Application in which Power Spectral Density of each frequency band is extracted from brain wave signals and theta to beta ratio, which highly correlates with stress level, is evaluated. This approach makes use of K-Means Clustering followed by Support Vector Machine (SVM) to classify the stress into 3 levels i.e. stressed, intermediate and not stressed. The relevant music is recommended depending stress level of the individual. The proposed methodology aims to facilitate relaxation for individuals dealing with panic and high-stress scenarios by leveraging the therapeutic benefits of music.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Model to Detect Spam on Instagram
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In recent years, social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram have become increasingly significant as channels for the diffusion of information. One of these social media platforms that has grown in popularity recently is Instagram. Instagram is a popular network for sharing photos and videos that generate income for celebrities, businesses, and people with large followings. The site could potentially be used for illegal activities because of its enormous profit margin. One of the malicious activities on the Instagram network involves fake accounts. In this study, a hybrid approach that considers both the post's content and the images has been used for identifying Instagram fake accounts. We evaluate content spam with machine learning, and image spam with CNN models. The image dataset has been taken from Image Spam Hunter, and the model was trained using a dataset from Kaggle for categorization based on content. The proposed hybrid model has also been tested on the dataset that was scraped from Instagram. Experimental classification results show that the proposed model has a classification accuracy of 97.1%.

articleTitle: Detecting Violations of Conditional Functional Dependencies in Distributed Database
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper develops a technique for detecting violations of conditional functional dependencies in distributed database systems. For a given database that has a set of functional dependencies as a data quality rule, we want to identify tuples in the database that violate these rules. When the provided database is a centralized database, there have been simple SQL-based techniques available for finding violations of the conditional functional dependencies for this particular database. However, it is more challenging to detect violations in distributed databases. Numerous works already published concentrate on functional dependency error estimation in centralized settings where data are kept in a single place, with the aim of reducing the time and space requirements of the estimation methods. With the design and execution of the heuristic algorithm, a remedy for breaches of conditional functional dependencies in the distributed database is suggested. Our key goal for the distributed data is to solve the shipment issue. To assess the efficacy of our plan and algorithm, a series of experiments are created and carried out.

articleTitle: Utilizing Correlation Analysis for Validation of Image Datasets in Lower Spine Diagnosis: A Study on MRI Image Dataset from Multiple Labs in Punjab
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: For the purposes of making a diagnosis of a condition affecting the lower spine, the collection of data is an obligatory requirement. It's possible that the data that was obtained was in the form of text, but it may also have been an image. The gathering of data in the work that is being suggested is, to a primary extent, dependent upon picture datasets. MRI image dataset compiled by travelling to a number of different labs in Punjab (Pathankot) and making use of the internet as a method of gathering. The utilisation of correlation analysis is what enables the validation of datasets to become a reality. The data that has been obtained has inconsistencies that need to be fixed in order to be useful. The pre-processing mechanism that comprises edge detection and contrast stretching is also illustrated through the use of this proposed study's use of the procedure, along with the result of employing the technique. A comparison of the outcomes achieved by utilising methods such as histogram equivalence and slicing in conjunction with contrast stretching gives the largest possible result of contrast stretching. This conclusion was reached after doing the comparison. Only 3032 of the dataset's 5000 samples exhibit a positive connection; hence, only those samples were maintained to indicate decreased spine detection. The dataset contains a total of 5000 samples. The dataset contains samples that were collected from a wide range of laboratories.

articleTitle: Maximize Throughput of Emergency Data in WBAN Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) has sparked a lot of attention because of its self-automation and superior technology. Many researchers have worked in this field. The most difficult challenge for WBAN is to handle diverse traffic in a network with limited resources. Because of their crucial nature, some sensed data are regarded as more significant than others in the healthcare WBAN. Such kind of vital information must be given within a specific time frame. In these systems, data delivery with loss and delay may not be accepted; hence, the use of an intelligent algorithm to copse with these systems is required. As a result, this technology may be used in medical critical circumstances to diagnose and treat patients promptly. To improve the classification accuracy, random forest (RF) and support vector machine (SVM) classifiers are used; these are machine learning techniques. This approach is in charge of determining the class of each incoming packet and assigning a priority to it.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Decentralized Platform for Electronic Health Records Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: EHRs (Electronic Health Records) have gained significant importance in the healthcare industry as they provide healthcare providers with the capability to digitally capture, store, and share patient health information (PHI). This enables a more efficient exchange of patient data and contributes to the seamless delivery of healthcare services. However, the current EHR systems have limitations in terms of security, privacy, interoperability, and data integrity. Blockchain technology, with its decentralized and immutable nature, has the potential to address these limitations by providing a secure and transparent platform for storing and exchanging PHI. This paper proposes a blockchain-based EHR system that leverages the benefits of blockchain to improve the privacy, interoperability, and security of EHRs. We discuss the design and implementation of the proposed system, including the use of smart contracts for managing consent and access control. We also assess the performance and scalability of the suggested system and compare it with traditional EHR systems. Our results demonstrate that the proposed system provides a secure and efficient platform for managing EHRs, which can help to improve the quality of healthcare services and patient outcomes. The results of the proposed system are evaluated on the basis of security and accessibility.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Academic Bank of Credit Management System for Higher Education: An Innovative Approach to Student Credentialing and Progression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The traditional higher education system has long relied on manual processes for managing student credentials, resulting in inefficiencies and delays in certification and credit recognition. In response to the new guidelines set by the University Grants Commission (UGC) regarding a credit-based system, this research paper presents a novel blockchain-based credit management platform for higher education institutions. Leveraging the decentralized and immutable nature of blockchain technology, this system aims to revolutionize student credentialing, credit accumulation, and academic progression. The proposed platform employs a public blockchain network, with different colleges and the central university acting as nodes, ensuring transparency, security, and tamper-resistant storage of student information and academic records. The implementation starts with students registering their information, including personal details and academic history, on the blockchain. This step guarantees the authenticity and accessibility of their records throughout their academic journey. The blockchain-based credit management system enhances the student's ownership of their academic records, fostering a decentralized, secure, and trustless environment. The use of smart contracts streamlines administrative processes, reducing bureaucratic overheads, and improving the overall efficiency of the education ecosystem. Furthermore, the transparency offered by the blockchain ensures that students' achievements are accurately recognized and acknowledged by potential employers and other institutions.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Squat Correctness System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Achieving visible results through working out requires consistent repetition of exercises. However, practicing improper posture during exercises such as squats or bench presses can cause significant and lasting damage. In addition, it reduces the effectiveness of the workout and improper muscle engagement increases the risk of injury. It is common for beginners to exercise with incorrect form, which can result in various problems such as muscle Strains or tears, joint pain and tendonitis. The paper proposes a method based on Pose estimation where it primarily uses keypoints of the body to identify incorrect posture and gives a feedback based on it.

articleTitle: A Multistep Ahead Predictive Analysis of Crude Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The population is increasing in a rapid manner and the number of vehicles is increasing in the same ratio. Also, crude oils are very useful towards the energy needs in the industries. As a result, a day will come when we face the issue of feeling the vehicles with the petrol to run the vehicle and to run the industries. So, the solution is to find out the period up to which we can use the crude oil which is currently present in the world. To get a conclusion the most populated countries India and China is taken as reference. For simulation purpose time series based Artificial Neural Network application along with Facebook Prophet is used. Facebook Prophet is used to predict future situations in time series data related to oil production and consumption in two top countries by population, China, and India, over a period of 32 years. NeuralProphet is used for modelling time-series based on neural networks forecasting the near-term oil crisis. The dataset used in this study contains three characteristics, namely population, oil production, and consumption, and is obtained from different government sources. The best part of this model is that it can predict multi step ahead of given current data as required. The method based on NeuralProphet is best suit for the time series prediction for short period or long period. It can be used in multistep ahead prediction methods. It is predicted that by 2050 the scarcity of the petroleum is most. So, the solution is either to reduce the uses of vehicles, control the population or simply go for an alternate fuel like hydrogen could be considered a suitable substitute for oil. This prediction highlights the need for sustainable energy sources to meet the energy demand in the future. In conclusion, this paper presents NeuralProphet approach for forecasting future oil consumption and production trends combining the Facebook Prophet and NeuralProphet method.

articleTitle: Contemporary Machine Learning Approach for Anomaly Based Network Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Networks must be protected from suspicious activity using anomaly-based network intrusion detection. In the past, machine learning techniques have become more important while addressing network security issues. High detection rates and low false alarm rates are the main objectives of intrusion detection systems (IDS). Despite being widely used, classification-based machine learning methods are ineffective in identifying unidentified threats in the network. In our research, machine learning techniques are primarily used to create anomaly-based intrusion detection systems that draw information from the training phase from the data. However, current intrusion detection techniques cover the most recent kinds of behaviors like DDoS attackers, Probes, U2Rs, and R2Ls, the difficult problem in this section is low false alarm rate. Nearly all network IDS rely on the network's deployed environment. Our suggested approach offers a quick and precise features selection process while attempting to be independent of the deployed environment network.

articleTitle: SECURELY - A Golang CLI Tool for Secure File Sharing with Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper proposes a confidential file-sharing system based on Shamir's secret sharing technique. Data is encrypted using the secure Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme. After hashing the key with SHA-256, the file is encrypted with AES-256. The encrypted file has been partitioned into n shares, which fulfils the admin's required minimum threshold. The file can be decrypted by collaborators once the threshold is achieved. This system offers superior processing and security compared to other methods, making it a robust solution for secure file sharing on various platforms.

articleTitle: Addressing Semantic Similarity Attacks in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: An efficient technique for preserving user privacy of users while publishing data is anonymization. Banks, Social Network service providers and hospitals are examples of data owners/stakeholders who anonymize their customers' data before releasing it in order to protect users' privacy. However, trustworthy information consumers still value anonymous data. Numerous anonymization models and techniques have been developed for releasing data while preserving user privacy. These models/algorithms de-identify user data, which is typically presented as graphs. Giving clear perspectives on the entire information privacy field, including recent anonymization research, tabular and SN data, is crucial. In this article, we proposed an approach for anonymization to address privacy issues in social networks specifically addressing semantic similarity attacks. Far as we are aware, our proposed technique is capable of resolving the issues of semantic similarity between sensitive attributes efficiently. The results of the proposed approach have been evaluated using the dataset of around 6000 users of a real-time social network viz. Twitter. Evaluation metrics of APL (Average Path Length) show that our technique can protect privacy and also maintain the utility of data while publishing it for public use.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Prediction and Analysis between Supervised and Unsupervised Learning with XAI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The stock market is a topic that is of interest to all sorts of people. It is a place where the prices change very drastically. So, something needs to be done to help the people risking their money on the stock market. The public's opinions are crucial for the stock market. Sentiment is a very powerful force that is constantly changing and having a significant impact. It is reflected on social media platforms, where almost the entire country is active, as well as in the daily news. Many projects have been done in the stock prediction genre, but since sentiments play a big part in the stock market, making predictions of prices without them would lead to inefficient predictions, and hence Sentiment analysis is very important for stock market price prediction. To predict stock market prices, we will combine sentiment analysis from various sources, including News and Twitter. Results are evaluated for two different cryptocurrencies: Ethereum and Solana. Random Forest achieved the best RMSE of 13.434 and MAE of 11.919 for Ethereum. Support Vector Machine achieved the best RMSE of 2.48 and MAE of 1.78 for Solana.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Karnatakaelection2023 Twitter Dataset Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Platforms for social networking, such as Twitter have a ton of user-generated content that users can access. The global user base's ability to exchange thoughts, feelings, and perspectives on a variety of topics, increases the value of sentiment analysis in predicting outcomes and choosing the best course of action as needed. Users of the social networking and microblogging service namely twitter can send status updates with a maximum of 140 characters. Considering the sentiments expressed in the tweets in the context is one of the important current usage. Sentiment analysis is used to identify and categorize opinions as positive, neutral, or negative by separating them from different content formats including news, audits, and articles. The present work composed a dataset using the Twitter API based on the tweets of the Karnataka election in 2023. The dataset was then pre-processed to make it useful for the use of machine learning methods. Naive Bayes Classifier machine learning classification algorithm was used to classify the tweets into the desired attitudes. With the Naive Bayes Classifier, 82.05% accuracy was achieved. The outcome of the proposed work will be helpful in tracking social media to get insights into the upcoming activities.

articleTitle: Certifier Dapp - Decentralized and Secured Certification System Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Current certification systems suffer from various problems such as vulnerability to fraud, time-consuming verification processes, delays in obtaining certificates, limited access due to geographical limitations, high costs, outdated content, lack of flexibility, credibility concerns, quality control issues, technical difficulties, limited interaction, limited feedback, and barriers to access. To address these problems, we propose a solution in the form of Certifier Dapp, a decentralized application built on the Ethereum blockchain. The Certifier Dapp leverages the MetaMask wallet for authentication and communication with the blockchain and offers functionalities such as issuing new certificates, updating issued certificates, verifying certificates, and tracking change history. Utilizing blockchain technology, the Certifier Dapp ensures data integrity, immutability, transparency, and security. The proposed solution aims to provide a seamless and efficient certification process, overcoming the limitations of current certification systems and making certification more accessible and credible for users.

articleTitle: Accurate Face Mask Detection Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has highlighted the importance of face masks in preventing the spread of the virus. Automated face mask detection systems can play an important role in enforcing mask-wearing policies in public places. In this paper, a deep learning-based approach for face mask detection using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is proposed. The performance of the approach on a large dataset of face images with and without masks. The results show that the approach achieves an accuracy of 98.5%. The effectiveness of the approach on real-world scenarios by applying it to video streams are demonstrated. The proposed system can be used in various settings, including airports, hospitals, schools, and public transport, to detect whether people are wearing masks or not.

Author Keywords: Face Mask Detection Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: A Survey on Shared Perceptions, Help Seeking Patterns and Awareness of Cyber Bullying Among Bangladeshi Citizens
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Cyber Bullying is one of the major social problems now-a-days which is called “Digital Crime”. Prevention of this problem has become the need of the hour. The main goal of this study is to find out the condition of Cyber Bullying cases among different genders, what do they actually do when they face it and what are their thinking against this major crime. The data set is collected from different professionals such as students, teachers, housewives, doctors etc via google form. The data set was dividend into 897 rows with 11 columns. The libraries that were used to analyze the data set are Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn etc. The data set has both responses of victim and non-victim people. The summary of this study says that women face cyber bullying more than men and the major opinion of the victims is, there are no efficient laws against this issue. People used to ask for help from their family and friends rather than police or institutional authorities. The major approaches to combat this cyber crime are to provide personal counseling and assistance regarding cyber bullying as well as open training on how to use personal information wisely on the internet.

articleTitle: An IOT-Based Smart Bag with Integrated Security System and Rainwear
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper suggests the proposal and development of an IoT -based smart bag with an integrated security system and rainwear. The smart bag is equipped with various modules, including a GPS module, and an Arduino board. The bag is designed to provide real-time tracking and monitoring of its location and the safety and security of its contents. The integrated security system includes a charging system that consists of a power bank in the bag. Additionally, the bag is equipped with a rainwear system that contains an inbuilt raincoat at the back section. The bag is connected to the internet through the GSM module, enabling users to remotely monitor its location and receive alerts in case of any security breach. The proposed smart bag can be used for various applications, including travel, outdoor activities, personal use, etc.

articleTitle: Voting Based CrowdFunding Using Ethereum Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The Crowdfunding is a type of fundraising for the people in need. Its main objective is to raise funds from investors such that they can provide it to its requesters. The traditional crowdfunding are not trustable as there are third parties involved which cause security breaches. The blockchain technology can help in strengthening the security of the crowdfunding platform as it is transparent and accessible to all, decentralised platform. The most important property of the crowdfunding is the mutual trust between the entities which can be established by using blockchain. This paper majorly focuses on what is crowdfunding, usage of blockchain technology via smart contracts in Ethereum and its advantages through a functional application, its limitations and future scope. It also compares other platforms with the platform developed using Ethereum blockchain and Smart contracts with the traditional as well as the blockchain platforms.

articleTitle: Golf Shot Swing Recognition Using Dense Optical Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper introduces a computer vision-based methodology for identifying golf swings. The proposed approach utilizes videographic data of golf swings and recognizes swing type and postures such as Backswing, Downswing, and Follow Through. The system experiments with techniques such as Dense and Sparse Optical Flow to identify the Golf club's trajectory. The features of these trajectories are then extracted using Histogram of Oriented Gradients. To create a resilient model, the feature of golfer's posture during a specific swing is extracted using Scale-Invariant Feature Transform with morphological image frame. The extracted features are normalized, concatenated, and classified using various classification techniques. When evaluated on the standard GolfDB dataset, the system achieves an Accuracy of 84.4 percent for Random Forest classification with a Precision Score of 0.7949. This study proposes a promising approach to identify golf swings using computer vision techniques, which could potentially have implications in enhancing performance analysis in the field of sports.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accident Detection System Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Accident detection systems play a pivotal role in ensuring prompt aid and response during critical occurrences. This study centers on devising an accident detection system through the utilization of the Tinkercad simulator. Specifically, the system harnesses the power of an Arduino Uno R3 microcontroller in conjunction with an array of sensors and components. The integrated framework encompasses diverse sensors, including a PIR sensor, TMP36 temperature sensor, gas sensor, tilt sensor, and RGB LED. Complementary actuators such as a piezo buzzer, positional micro servo, and red LED further enrich the system's functionality. This research showcases the design and realization of the accident detection system using the Tinkercad simulator, offering an economically viable and pragmatic means of identifying accidents and providing instantaneous aid. The modular architecture of the system ensures scalability and adaptability to meet specific requisites. The simulation outcomes underscore the efficacy and dependability of the proposed system in discerning accidents and expediting timely interventions.

articleTitle: Measuring and Mitigating Gender Bias in Contextualized Word Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Deep learning models like Transformers revolutionize the execution of automated tasks. However, these models are prone to many biases that can perpetuate societal inequalities. Sometimes disclosure of gender information by these models may lead to privacy related issues. These models are exploited most for Natural language processing (NLP) tasks and have attracted the attention of researchers to examine the inherent societal bias in them. In this paper we devise a post-processing mechanism that measure and mitigate the gender bias in the contextualized embeddings of the T5 model (Text-to-Text-Transfer-Transformer model).

articleTitle: Hybrid Clustering Techniques for Optimizing Online Datasets Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Data elements of the same group are used in the clustering procedure. The most common clustering algorithm is based on initially chosen centroids randomly, which is the K-mean. The K-means clustering algorithm comprises numerical and category attributes that suffer from significant difficulty in initializing the cluster centre for large datasets. This paper suggests a hybrid K-Harmonic clustering algorithm that tries to overcome the problem of cluster center initialization of data with enormous datasets and numbers. By arranging the data, It is possible to improve the K-Harmonic means clustering method and was randomly used earlier for mixed datasets, making a new hybrid algorithm for K-Harmonic means. A definition is presented for the cluster's hub and a distance measure by using K-Harmonic means clustering function. Trials were conducted with pure large mixed datasets and categorical datasets of online shopping malls. Results imply that the effectiveness of the suggested grouping technique is unaffected by the initialization difficulty of the cluster. It has been shown through comparative studies of complexity and accuracy utilizing additional clustering methods and a variety of datasets that the suggested approach yields superior clustering results.

articleTitle: Role of Block-Chain in Health-Care Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Because of the upgraded security and protection it gives, block chain innovation has been embraced in various ventures, including medical care. The ability to give members right and quick admittance to their wellbeing records is perhaps of the main asset in medical care frameworks. Because of block chain innovation's changelessness, decentralization, and security, the medical care industry might encounter change. Versatility, nonetheless, is a significant issue with block bind frameworks because of the record innovation and agreement methods used in those frameworks. Block chain sharding is a critical strategy for tending to the versatility issue in block organizations. Block-chain sharding addresses the versatility issues of block-chains by basically partitioning the organization into discrete gatherings, or shards, that execute exchanges in equal. In this paper, we give a decentralized and more versatile sharding worldview for overseeing medical care information. As per the review, a sharding philosophy based wellbeing application ought to be utilized, with patient solicitations used to make the shards. The suggested strategy can deal with a lot of medical services information while holding more noteworthy exchange speeds and further developed effectiveness, which recommends that it can possibly expand the versatility of blockchain-based wellbeing applications.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Enabled Disease Prediction System in Healthcare Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In each industry where innovative progressions are at their most elevated, machine learning has been greatly valuable. The objective of machine learning is to extricate the foremost exact forecasts and comes about from a tremendous cluster of databases. One industry that requires fastidious investigation of critical sums of information to reach conclusions is healthcare. Machin learning has the potential to be a valuable instrument for making a difference therapeutic experts make choices and can moreover react to patients' questions around their indications. The work offers a lung illness prediction model, helping doctors, based on their database, to make better predictions on patients. Using patient's historical and present medical records, disease prediction is improved. Additionally, parallel image-based categorization is used to offer more precise and reliable illness analysis. The system may be used by a variety of connected parties, including hospitals to forecast patient outcomes and effective resource allocation, health insurance providers to identify high-risk individuals, and pharmaceutical firms to find potential new drug targets. To support the created model, a comparison of various algorithms is provided. Overall, the healthcare sector can gain from the development of this type of model in ways that enhance patient outcomes and facilitate effective decision-making.

articleTitle: The Use of Blockchain Technology to Verify KYC Documents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Sensitive personal data is frequently uploaded on internet, which is currently misused or disclosed leading to compromise of financial assets and thus endangering the entire ecosystem for online transactions. As a result, academic resources as well as internet firms are interested in learning how to manage an online identity. We propose a solution that provides user with authority over their own identities, using Blockchain Based (BCB) identity management system. Proposed system allows users to store data on a blockchain in place of vulnerable servers. The blockchain enables users to securely register their personal information and documents, guaranteeing the immutability and integrity of their identification of data. Organizations on the other hand, play crucial role in using proposed BCB system to verify identity of persons for their requirements like recruitments, loan sanctioning, asset management, admission to schools and colleges. The proposed solution provides a blockchain network for user to store the KYC details for identification purpose. It also provides platform for users and organizations to join blockchain network and retrieve the KYC documents of the required persons. The verifier in blockchain network verifies the identity of person. Block chain is made lightweight using blockchain server. Reward system is introduced to motivate users/organizations in blockchain network to participate in verification of KYC document of any user.

articleTitle: A Review of the Authentication Scheme Using HECC and ECC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In today's hyper-connected globe, safe and secure interaction is becoming increasingly essential, which has raised the need for trusted verification systems. The expanding dependence on electronic systems together with interconnected systems has triggered complicated cyber risks requiring the use of durable cryptographic methods to maintain the honesty, privacy, and credibility of transmitted information. These points have been produced by the increasing dependence on electronic systems coupled with interconnected systems. To enhance verification procedures and give feedback on the problems offered, scientists and specialists have been continually examining unique cryptographic methods. In this work, a complete evaluation of the Authentication Protocol making use of hyperelliptic curve cryptography (HECC) is presented. Our objective is to provide a detailed examination of the mathematical foundations, necessary homes, and defense devices of the HECC-based verification system's assessing the advantages as well as disadvantages of the method, we wish to show its possible usage in modern-day cryptographic systems as a verification technique that is both risk-free and reliable.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Financial Enterprises Credit Value Information System Using Federated AI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain is a distributed digital ledger system that enables the safe, transparent, and decentralised management of records. Rather than being managed by a single central authority, it is essentially a database of transactions. A block of transactions is created in a blockchain network once each transaction has been confirmed by a number of network nodes. A block that has been added to the chain cannot be changed after that point, creating a tamper-proof record of all network transactions. Blockchain has numerous other possible applications than cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, which is occasionally the case. For instance, they can be applied to voting procedures, supply chain management, and even digital identity management. The security of blockchain is one of its main advantages. In this paper, we discussed the blockchain is exceedingly hard to tamper with because each transaction is confirmed by many network nodes. Blockchain technology does, however, have significant drawbacks. A blockchain, for instance, may take a lot of computing power to maintain, and the number of transactions that can be executed each second may be constrained. Additionally, since blockchain transactions are irreversible, there is no way to get back any money that has been misplaced or stolen.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security, Privacy, and Scalability in Blockchain and Internet of Things (IoT): A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The integration of the blockchain era with Internet of Things (IoT) devices holds first-rate promise for boosting safety, privacy, and scalability in IoT ecosystems. This research paper deals with the existing research on blockchain integration with IoT devices and explores the associated concerns in phrases of security, privacy, and scalability. It also elaborates how blockchain can enable agreement with information provenance and steady interactions within IoT ecosystems. By examining present literature studies and enterprise practices, it presents insights into the capability benefits and demanding situations of adopting the blockchain era in IoT deployments. It additionally presents use cases, applications, and its challenges towards the blockchain-enabled IoT systems on security, privacy, and scalability, contributing to the expertise of this rising discipline.

articleTitle: Offside Detection for Better Decision-Making and Gameplay in Football
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Offside detection is a crucial aspect of fair play in soccer, and computer vision has the potential to automate this process. In this paper, we present an innovative technique for offside detection using computer vision techniques. We leverage the HOG algorithm for human detection and then color histograms for team classification of players. We also introduce a custom algorithm for detecting the last players in the frame and checking for possible offside conditions. We conducted experiments on a publicly available soccer dataset DFL Bundesliga Data Shootout[1] to evaluate the performance of our approach. Our results demonstrate that our method achieves high accuracy in detecting offside events in real-time. Our approach can be used for various applications, such as referee decision-making and tactical gameplay analysis. To summarize, this work emphasizes the promise of computer vision for automating offside identification in football and proposes a realistic approach to this objective.

articleTitle: Efficient Solution for NoSQL Database Security in Blockchain - Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In recent years many applications have moved to blockchain-based services due to the increased popularity of blockchain technology. The implementation of this technology in numerous domain applications, such as finance, health management, land record registration, etc. As a result, data security and privacy are essential requirements of the Blockchain platform for protecting users' sensitive data and code. In this paper, a database security framework is proposed specifically tailored for Blockchain-based solutions, including projects based on Hyperledger. Furthermore, this framework detects vulnerabilities in MongoDB and CouchDB and suggests remedial actions. The solution identifies missing patches, exposed Config API, unauthorized changes, misconfigured privileges, and more.

articleTitle: Anomalous Behavior Detection in Surveillance Cameras Using Optical Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This project aims to develop a system for detecting suspicious anomalous behavior, specifically fighting in public spaces using computer vision methods and machine learning algorithms. The proposed system will be capable of analyzing video data captured by surveillance cameras and detecting anomalous events, such as physical disputes, which may compromise public safety. The project consists of three parts, each utilizing a distinct methodology. The first methodology is based on optical flow and magnitude thresholding. The second methodology uses Farneback optical flow angles features with random forest and HOG human overlapping feature, while the third methodology uses background subtraction and two-class SVM with ‘rbf’ kernel and 5-fold cross validation and using voting classifier. Through the implementation of these techniques, this paper aims to provide an effective solution for detecting abnormal behavior from videos. The presented system, with an SVM model accuracy of 86%, demonstrates the potential to assist law enforcement agencies in detecting and preventing criminal activities in public spaces, thus improving public safety through the application of advanced machine learning techniques. The effectiveness of the system will be widely accepted benchmark datasets, and results have been analyzed with existing methods.

articleTitle: Smart Identity Management System Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In the digital era, identity management is essential due to the growing cyber threats and weaknesses in the national ID systems now in place. It is difficult to get and update IDs using the current manual procedure. With an emphasis on data security and transparency, this article offers a blockchain-based identity management system to address these concerns. The suggested system auto-starts from birth, creating distinctive IDs and keeping extensive data, such as national ID information, academic credentials, and more. It is built using blockchain technology, which offers security and user control over identification data. This technology provides a secure, decentralized platform that improves privacy and identity data security. It has the potential to transform identity management across multiple sectors, notwithstanding implementation difficulties. The paper provides a comprehensive analysis of our projected smart identity management system for Bangladesh, beginning with an overview of the system's architecture, proof-of-work, workflow, and required procedures for developing a functional prototype. The system's architecture is based on blockchain technology, which offers a secure and decentralized platform for keeping identity information. In order to increase privacy and security, the architecture is designed to give users control over their identity information. The system is intended to offer a decentralized, safe, and open platform for handling identity data while protecting the confidentiality of individual user information. The advantages of employing this system make it a potential alternative for strengthening the security and privacy of identification information, notwithstanding the difficulties connected with its implementation.

articleTitle: Blockchain Applications in Smart Grid: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The smart grid, envisioning a modernized and intelligent electric power system, stands to significantly benefit from the inclusion of blockchain technology in it. Blockchain offers a decentralized, secure, and tamper-proof platform that addresses various challenges faced by the conventional grid. This paper provides an introduction to blockchain technology, providing details about, its component, types of networks and consensus mechanisms used in it. It then highlights the diverse applications of blockchain across various industries. Subsequently this paper explores blockchain's application in the smart grid domain, emphasizing its potential to revolutionize peer to peer (P-2-P) energy trading, energy management, security and energy trading in Electric vehicle. Finally, the paper examines various challenges associated with the addition of blockchain into the smart grid, encompassing scalability, interoperability, security, data privacy, and regulatory limitations.

articleTitle: Privacy and Security in Blockchain: A Comprehensive Analysis of Techniques and Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: With its decentralised, secure, and transparent solutions, blockchain technology has become a paradigm-shifting force in a variety of industries. This comprehensive review moves around the complex world of blockchain applications, thoroughly classifies each type, analyses current issues, and looks ahead to potential future applications. The study, which spans industries including finance, healthcare, supply chain, and more, highlights how blockchain has the power to completely transform data management, transparency, and trust. The public, private, consortium, hybrid blockchain types are all systematically categorised in the study and each is suited to a different set of needs. The assessment highlights how blockchain's architecture can transform sectors that previously relied on middlemen by emphasising decentralised consensus methods. Key considerations include issues with interoperability, scalability, data privacy, and regulatory compliance. Based upon current literature in the field, the study emphasises the urgent necessity for comprehensive research and innovative approaches in order to address these gaps and facilitate the appropriate implementation of blockchain technology. This analysis gives a complete summary of the uses, problems, and future trajectories of this omnipotent technology. It serves as a necessary guide for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers, as they navigate the growing influence of blockchain.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Secured and Privacy Protected Academic Certificate Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain is a decentralized data storage and management technology that has gained interest since it emerged. This growing interest in the Blockchain is due to its primary features like shared ledger processing, disintermediation in transactional processing, tamper resistance nature, trustworthiness, provenance, immutability, finality, data integrity, etc. Therefore, Blockchain creates compelling use cases in various domains such as energy, agriculture, health, finance, manufacturing, telecommunication, Education, etc. Despite practical implementations in different real-time critical problems, few works prevail in the education domain using Blockchain. Learning is a continuous process and essential for human development, and Education is the most valuable resource a person can acquire in his lifetime. Hence, this paper proposes a Blockchain-based architecture for academic certificate management systems, which ensures authentication, integrity, non-repudiation, and tamper resistance in educational credentials. As security and trust come as an in-built feature of blockchain-based architecture, the proposed system focuses on building privacy persevering Blockchain for certificate management, which mitigates fraudulent certificate circulation. Also, one of the disadvantages of Blockchain-based systems is that they are not scalable. Still, the certificate creation, storage, and verification system has to scale for more users according to their needs. Thus, the paper proposes a scalable blockchain system for academic certificate management.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Education 4.0: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: As the Fourth Industrial Revolution marks the beginning of an era of digitization, key principles like inter-operability, decentralisation, and virtualisation are significantly impacting a variety of fields, including education. Aiming to combine traditional educational techniques with cutting-edge ICT-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence, automation, and blockchain, this paradigm coined as “Education 4.0” intertwines with “Industry 4.0”. With its intrinsic qualities of decentralisation, immutability, consensus, and transparency, blockchain stands up as an effective solution to problems like governance and credential credibility of the courses in which the student is enrolled can be resolved. This paper has contribution in four folds. This paper makes four significant contributions to literature. It begins by highlighting the goals of Education 4.0 and the relationship between modern teaching methods with cutting-edge technology. It then delves into an analysis of blockchain protocols, spotlighting their alignment with the DeFi protocol stack. The next part divides blockchain projects into four distinct categories, following which reviews diverse blockchain-powered projects in education, evaluating their implementations, advantages, and potential drawbacks.

articleTitle: AgroMart: A Decentralized Farmers' Market Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Traditional supply chains in the agriculture business are afflicted by several major concerns, such as many parties, difficulty in communication brought on by an extended supply chain timeline, a lack of confidence, and a centralized system. However, there is a solution to these problems: the decentralized system. Due to the intricate and interrelated nature of agricultural supply chains, it can be particularly challenging to keep track of product safety or quality issues. This is especially true for the core agricultural food supply networks that make up the daily diets of most people. One of the persistent problems that had been plaguing the mechanisms used for food supply chain traceability has been solved thanks to the development of blockchain technology. Blockchain has evolved as a prominent technology since it can provide secure traceability and control, immutability, and the creation of stakeholder confidence in a cost-effective information technology solution. The widespread implementation of blockchain technology in supply chains is being hampered by several problems, even though blockchain is having a significant impact in a great many other areas. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based application with the purpose of directly connecting local farmers and proprietors of small-scale grocery shops with one another, eliminating the requirement for a third party to act as an intermediary.

articleTitle: FedRH: Federated Learning Based Remote Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: More and more people are developing chronic illnesses, which require regular visits to the hospital for treatment and monitoring. Due to the advancements in wearable computing technology, there is a growing interest in remote health monitoring worldwide. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices allow users to access their health data. Recent developments in smart healthcare have shown that machine learning model training using vast amounts of healthcare data has been remarkably successful. However, remote healthcare is facing a significant challenge as user data is stored in isolated silos, thus making data aggregation impractical while ensuring data privacy and security. To overcome this challenge, this paper presents FedRH, a federated learning framework for remote healthcare. FedRH solves the issue of data isolation through a cloud-edge-based computing architecture and FL, providing personalized healthcare without sacrificing privacy and security. Experiments show that FedRH achieves a greater accuracy of 5.6% compared to conventional approaches. FedRH is a flexible and versatile tool that can be applied to various healthcare applications, making it an ideal choice for many use cases.

articleTitle: Identification and Categorization of Brain Tumors Using HOG Feature Descriptor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The precise diagnosis of brain tumors is aided by early detection, which is essential in medical diagnostics. Medical diagnosis using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a viable alternative, but manual inspection is difficult owing to the enormous volumes of data and fine nuances. Radiologists depend on the ability to recognize cancers in MRI scans, which is where computer-aided diagnostics come into play. One of the most common and fatal malignancies, brain tumors can shorten a person's typical lifetime. The survival of patients with brain tumors is improved by early identification. Medical imaging can be difficult to use to detect tumors because of their dimensions, form, and place. It is essential to comprehend these specifics in order to understand and categorize malignancies. In medical imaging, machine learning techniques may distinguish between tumor and healthy pictures. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification make up a suggested strategy for improving the simplicity of identifying brain cancers. Raw data is preprocessed to remove noise, and HOG feature description is used to extract features. The system's accuracy is assessed using a variety of machine learning classifiers, such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gradient Boost, K Nearest Neighbor (KNN), XG Boost, and Logistic Regression. The classifier with the best accuracy, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XG Boost), achieves nearer to 92%.

articleTitle: Homomorphic Encryption for Secure Computation of White Patch Area in Binarized Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In specific categories of medical images, pathological abnormalities appear as white patches where the area of the white patches plays a vital role in the diagnosis of the associated disorders. Currently, most medical records are hosted in Cloud Servers for low-cost storage and efficient dissemination. Invariably, the medical images are encrypted and then stored in the Cloud for security and privacy. Moreover, in many cases, homomorphic encryption is adopted to take advantage of the powerful computing capabilities of the Cloud Servers. In such a scenario, a novel homomorphic encryption method that enables the secured computation of the white patch area of a binary image is presented. For this specific task, the target plaintext image is represented in its binary format to demark the white patches. The secured calculation of the white patch area of the specified image in the Cloud server is achieved based on homomorphic matrix multiplications in the cipher domain. The simulated results show that the performance is better compared to its nearest competitor.

articleTitle: Different Scenarios of File Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In the digital era, escalating data volumes necessitate secure and scalable file-sharing solutions. This research develops a private cloud architecture to address this need. It provides scalability through distributed servers, accommodating numerous users and data needs. Robust access controls, including authentication and encryption, ensure data security. The architecture supports diverse network configurations, enabling seamless file sharing. Synchronization and versioning facilitate collaboration, ensuring data integrity. In summary, our private cloud architecture offers secure, scalable, and efficient file sharing for organizations across various network scenarios.

articleTitle: Case Study on Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Data security is crucial in modern communication and technology to protect sensitive information from theft, loss, or unauthorized access. Cryptography is widely used to ensure data security by converting data into an unintelligible format that can only be decoded using predefined algorithms known only to the intended recipients. Cryptography offers several benefits for data security, including confidentiality, authentication, integrity, availability, and identification of user data. Encryption and digital signatures are two common forms of cryptography. Encryption scrambles data into a format that can only be decoded by authorized individuals, while digital signatures authenticate the identity of the sender and ensure the data's integrity. The increasing use of the internet for communication and business has led to a rise in the risk of data theft and loss. Cybercriminals use various techniques to steal sensitive information, making it necessary to use cryptography to protect data from unauthorized users and cybercriminals. Cryptography provides essential tools for protecting sensitive information in the modern age. It ensures that data remains secure and can only be accessed by authorized individuals while offering benefits such as confidentiality, authentication, integrity, availability, and identification of user data.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Regression Techniques for Accurate House Price Prediction Using Machine Learning: A Statistical Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Accurate house price prediction is crucial in real estate. This research aims to build a reliable house price prediction model using regression techniques. We evaluate model performance through 3-fold cross-validation and employ the mean R2 score as the evaluation metric, measuring predictive capacity. The top-performing model undergoes hyperparameter tuning. Our findings shed light on the effectiveness of regression techniques in house price prediction, identifying the most accurate model.

articleTitle: Towards Adoption of Green Blockchain with Emphasis on Blockchain Type, Consensus Protocols, Data Sharding and Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain and related Distributed Ledger Technologies (DLT) are anticipated to transform a the world of web from a centralised document-sharing platform to a comprehensive decentralised platform that facilitates the exchange of digital currency and supports autonomous management of digital assets. The central server is susceptible to attacks, distrust and collusion. If the web can assure reliable, safe, and responsible updates among independent participants without the need for a centralized server, the perception of a decentralised web can be re-instantiated. One of the essential technologies required to restore the openness of the internet while maintaining its security is distributed ledger technology (DLT). DLTs may now totally handle business and legal transactions online, creating a more trustworthy and accountable environment. Blockchain technology marks a major breakthrough by removing the need for a centralised trusted authority in a widely distributed network. Instead, a consensus must be reached among several sources of trust, based on an algorithm, that this transaction may be believed to be legitimate. The consensus algorithms in blockchain technology offer an immutable and permanent record of a transaction that is immutable, trustworthy and secured. Consensus algorithms are however energy consuming because of their computation heavy nature. This has been a biggest inhibition towards blockchain adoption. The energy needs for committing a blockchain transaction is also governed by whether it is a public/permissioned blockchain, its consensus algorithm, onchain-offchain data and the code complexity of smart contracts. The paper presents a state-of art evaluation of the current blockchain platforms and cryptos and evaluate them with the energy consumptions. Additionally, it also proposes a framework architecture of a green blockchain application. A green blockchain refers to the implementation of environmentally sustainable algorithms, tools and platforms in blockchain technology, aiming to reduce energy consumption, carbon emissions, and promote eco-friendly operations with energy-efficient algorithms and strategies.

articleTitle: Back Propagation Neural Network-Based Routing Optimization for IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has fundamentally changed how we engage with the environment that surrounds us by facilitating the connection of various devices and the flow of data between them. However, as the complexity of IoT networks increases, effective routing becomes more and more important to guarantee that data transfer and network performance are at their best. It is possible that traditional routing algorithms would not be able to manage the size and fluidity of Internet of Things networks. Optimizing the routing of Internet of Things devices has necessitated the use of more cutting-edge methods, such as the Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN), which has been developed by researchers. In this research paper, we provide a unique strategy to handle the routing optimization issue in IoT by employing BPNNs. Back Propagation Neural Networks is a kind of neural network. By using the tremendous capabilities of artificial neural networks, the BPNN-based routing optimization intends to improve the efficacy of IoT networks as well as their adaptability.

articleTitle: IPFS-Blockchain Based Technology for Lease Agreement and Rental System in Real Estate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Rental and lease scams are becoming more common in India by the use of a rental property as a lure to obtain money from the landlord or prospective tenants. Unfortunately, these scams seek to extort money from prospective renters or the tenants by fake real estate agents and fake listings or by breaching the lease agreement, breach in rent payment and hiding the utility bill charges. These scams can occur with both, the tenant or the renter as the victim. The government also faces difficulty in monitoring and keeping track of the property tax. This paper proposes the adoption of blockchain technology to address this issue by creating a housing lease alliance chain through Smart Contracts which enables landlords and tenants to sign lease agreements, to incorporate utility bills while signing the contract and to automatically pay and collect rent on a regular basis. We also propose the use of an IPFS system (Interplanetary File System) for listing of properties and for the authenticity of property and personal identity information through government identification, making leasing safe and secure.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stock Price Prediction Using Hybrid Auto Regressor and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The prediction or estimation of stock prices remains a complex and formidable task for humans, given the volatile price trends of stocks attributed to various factors. Although traditional methods, such as Fundamental Analysis and Technical Analysis, are in use, there is a pressing need to enhance these methods to safeguard funds from potential losses due to unavoidable factors in the stock market. To this end, we have proposed a novel method that predicts stock trends using an Auto Regressor machine learning model that leverages time series data. The suggested model presupposes that a time series' present value depends on its previous values., and the relationship between them is linear, with the strength between them being determined by an autoregressive coefficient.

articleTitle: Implementing Secure Key Management and Distribution in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Key management is considered as an essential aspect of securing cloud-based systems and data. As more organizations move their operations to cloud, the need for secure and efficient key management solutions becomes increasingly important. En-suring security of cloud computing is essential as many users often store their sensitive information with the cloud providers. Cloud service providers offer Key Management Services (KMS) to manage cryptographic keys for their customers, but there are still several challenges related to key management in cloud environments, including key storage, access control, and key rotation. Our research project aims to address these challenges by developing a secure and efficient key management solution for cloud-based systems. We propose a system that uses a combination of various cloud services and encryption algorithms to generate, store, and manage cryptographic keys securely. Our system provides granular access controls, and strong encryption to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the keys. We believe that our proposed solution will help cloud service providers and organizations to manage their cryptographic keys more efficiently and securely, reducing the risk of unauthorized access and data breaches. This research paper provides a method to effectively manage, store and share the secret key between the parties using the concept of Threshold Cryptography.

articleTitle: Real-Time Survivor Detection in UAV Thermal Imagery Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In this proposed work, UAV Thermal Imagery technology, which was employed by earlier researchers, to detect the Real-Time Victims, was taken. Due to their great durability, low cost, ease of implementation, and versatility, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have experienced a considerable surge in use. UAVs can swiftly search the impacted region during a natural catastrophe like earthquakes, floods, etc. to help more survival. One of the main factors to develop a rescue system is Dataset. In the various research papers studied the respective researchers used different algorithms or methods to develop a dataset. Researchers used methods like Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, YOLO Algorithms, etc. A comparative analysis of the various techniques was made. Also, the description of the Knowledge distillation process, which was discovered by earlier researchers, is mentioned here. Observation realises that Deep Learning methods are better to design a UAV.

articleTitle: Agro-Ledger: Blockchain Based Framework for Transparency and Traceability in Agri-Food Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper presents a pioneering blockchain-based framework for enhancing traceability and transparency within the global agrifood supply chain. By seamlessly integrating blockchain technology and the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), the framework offers a robust solution to the industry's challenges. It weaves a narrative where each product's journey is securely documented in an unalterable digital ledger, accessible to all stakeholders. Real-time Internet of Things (IoT) sensors stand sentinel, monitoring variables crucial to product quality. With millions afflicted by foodborne diseases, substantial food wastage, and a strong consumer desire for transparency, this framework responds to a clarion call for change. Moreover, the framework's data-driven approach not only rejuvenates consumer confidence and product authenticity but also lays the groundwork for robust sustainability and toxicity assessments. In this narrative of technological innovation, the paper embarks on an architectural odyssey, intertwining the threads of blockchain and EVM to reimagine a sustainable, transparent, and trustworthy agrifood landscape.

articleTitle: Secure Platform as a Service Using Blockchain Technology (HYPERBASE)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain is a decentralized distributed ledger which provides persistence, anonymity and auditability due to the fact that it captivates a lot of observation from the community. Last ten years, blockchain technology has advanced and become practical for a wide range of applications outside the financial industry.
