Nevertheless, the difficulty of secured resources, which will frequently complicated to expensive also major executors will construct, provide, and also analyze a secured blockchain network which hold up the applications. The quality of their applications is somewhat impacted by the fact that the majority of regular developers or teams cannot guarantee the dependability and pledge of the blockchain network. In this study, the phrase “build a platform for Blockchain as a service(BaaS)refers to the process by providing blockchain services in cloud computing field, for example network configuration, system analyzing, reporting, andsmart contract report analysis. According to the service, the system may focus on the business code and research how to more effectively use blockchain technology to their business contexts but instead of worrying about maintenance and system monitoring. This paper makes a more comprehensive platform that addresses the drawbacks of the current hyperbase platforms, particularly in security and dependability. Additionally, it offers more sophisticated technological features like blockchain technologies and Detecting Security breaches in Identity Blockchain Systems. Moreover, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$B$</tex> aaS infrastructure's dependability and fresh trust issues brought along by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$B$</tex> aaS impair security, decentralization, and blockchain mechanisms.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered FinTech: Shaping the Future of Indian Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This study delves into the transformative influence of the blockchain technology on Indian FinTech enterprises within the context of Industry 5.0. It comprehensively examines the integration of FinTech across diverse industries, highlighting the unique challenges and opportunities specific to the Indian business landscape. Real-world applications exemplify blockchain's capabilities in enhancing security, optimizing payment processes, and strengthening identity verification. By evaluating the advantages and obstacles of adopting blockchain in Indian FinTech, including regulatory compliance and scalability concerns, the research sheds light on the convergence of Industry 5.0 and blockchain- powered FinTech. Notably, potential impacts are revealed, such as the emergence of novel business models, decentralized financial ecosystems, and improved customer experiences. In conclusion, this study encourages further exploration of blockchain's potential in shaping the future of Indian industries, inspiring innovative strategies, and providing valuable insights into future trends in leveraging blockchain for Indian FinTech within the Industry 5.0 paradigm.

articleTitle: Role of Technology for Credit Risk Management: A Bibliometric Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Technology has disrupted processes and dynamics of the market. Banking sector and financial institutions are struggling to manage the nonperforming assets. Willful default cases have become a concern. This paper examines the role of technology in credit risk management. Bibliometric analysis was done on Scopus database. The visualization was done using VOS viewer version 1.6.19. 86 documents were obtained in Scopus database. Credit management using technology has attracted the attention of researchers. 46% documents have been published between 2019 and 2022. Fintech credit appraisal, credit default learning algorithms and efficiency of credit assessment using technology emerged as the major research themes. Adoption of blockchain and AI for credit risk assessment eliminates the subjective human bias and brings transparency in credit management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Financial Fraud Detection in Bitcoin Networks Using Ensemble Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to bolster financial fraud detection within the Bitcoin network using ensemble deep learning models. By synergistically merging ensemble techniques with state-of-the-art deep learning methodologies, this study creates a robust framework that enhances security and trust in financial systems. Through meticulous data preprocessing and feature engineering, the proposed ensemble model, comprising Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Feedforward Neural Network (FNN), and Attention LSTM, undergoes comprehensive training and evaluation. Results underscore the ensemble's remarkable performance, surpassing individual models in accuracy, precision, and recall. Notably, the ensemble achieves an accuracy of 99.62%, along with exceptional precision and recall values exceeding 99%. These outcomes validate the ensemble's capacity to detect both fraudulent and legitimate transactions with unprecedented accuracy. By effectively combining advanced machine learning techniques with the intricacies of blockchain-based transactions, this research contributes to building a more secure and reliable financial ecosystem. The findings open avenues for future research, emphasizing the potential of ensemble deep learning models to fortify defenses against evolving financial fraud strategies, fostering trust and integrity in digital transactions.

articleTitle: Mnemonic Phrase Management and SIM Based Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for Mobile Wallets in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain has grown for various IT businesses and an exchange of cryptocurrencies. The cryptocurrency wallets are essential for storing and managing the digital assets and cryptocurrencies, especially for mobile users. However, the security concerns of the mobile devices and wallets hinder the wide adoption of blockchain technology on mobile devices. Therefore, there is a need of a highly secured mobile wallet for blockchain technology. To address this issue, this paper proposes an architecture for key management in blockchain based mobile wallet. It involves mobile SIM card, as a hardware component and mnemonic phrase to achieve Two-Factor Authentication (2FA). It applies Shamir's secrete sharing scheme in order to enhance the wallet security and robustness. The security analysis of the proposed architecture is performed by considering different attacks.

articleTitle: An Approach to Secure Decentralized Storage System Using Blockchain and Interplanetary File System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: With centralized storage systems, data is stored on large servers, which carries the risk of censorship, data loss, or information theft. Centralized storage services may have worked for years, but their weaknesses are becoming increasingly apparent. Some successful file-sharing platforms like Bittorrent and Napster have been successful, but they were meant to be for something other than infrastructure. This paper proposes a proof of concept to overcome some of the above problems or limitations in centralized storage systems. It also discusses a solution design that would enable users to store all their data in a secure decentralized storage system instead of a centralized server that relies on components such as Permissioned Blockchain along with an Interplanetary File System, which acts as a protocol, hypermedia, and a file-sharing peer-to- peer network. These components store and share data in a distributed file system, along with smart contracts and transaction managers that help enforce decentralized data storage.
